SELECT approve_status AS tabFlag, count(*) AS count FROM wms_delivery_plan WHERE is_deleted=FALSE GROUP BY approve_status

SELECT odp.id AS sourceId, odpd.id AS sourceDetailId, odp.code AS sourceCode, odp.to_warehouse_id AS channelId, odp.to_warehouse_name AS channelName, odp.approve_status AS approveStatus, odpd.sku_id, odpd.sku_no, odpd.is_combination, odpd.qty AS planQty, odpd.qty AS requisitionQty, odpd.platform_sku as platformSku, odpd.platform_sku_name as platformSkuName, odpd.platform_spu as asin, odpd.platform_fn_sku as fnSku, odpd.box_qty as boxQty, odp.type as deliveryPlanType, odp.shop_id as shopId, odp.shop_name as shopName, (select COALESCE(sum(rad.requisition_qty),0) from requisition_application ra inner join requisition_application_detail rad on ra.id = rad.main_id and rad.is_deleted = false where ra.is_deleted = false and ra.invalid_status = false and rad.source_detail_id = odpd.id) as alreadyRequisitionQty FROM wms_delivery_plan_detail odpd INNER JOIN wms_delivery_plan odp ON odp.id = odpd.main_id AND odpd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE odp.is_deleted = FALSE
AND odpd.id IN
#{detailId}
order by odp.id
